definition_zh: （皮肤的）老茧；硬结；（比喻）麻木不仁
definition_en: a hardened, thickened patch of skin; figuratively, unfeeling hardness of heart
core_image: 纤夫掌心一层磨不破的黄茧
scene: 老船夫摊开双手，掌心的茧硬如树皮。Years of oars left a callosity across his palms.
sceneCN: 这里 callosity 是「老茧」（第 1 个义项：皮肤因摩擦而增厚变硬之处）；句意是多年摇桨在他掌上磨出厚茧。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「长老茧的；（心）冷酷的」
同根名词，义为「（皮肤或骨头的）胼胝、骨痂」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「冷酷地」

senses.title: A hardened patch of skin
senses.definition: a thickened, hardened area of skin formed by pressure or friction
senses.definitionCN: 因长期受压或摩擦而增厚变硬的皮肤区域
senses.example: The gardener's callosities told of forty seasons of labour.
senses.exampleCN: 园丁手上的老茧诉说着四十个耕作季节。
senses.why: Latin callum meant hard skin, and the suffix -ity names the condition.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 callum 意为硬皮，-ity 词尾标示这种状态。

senses.title: Any hardened swelling
senses.definition: a hard thickened spot or mass, as on a bone or plant
senses.definitionCN: 硬化的增厚处或硬块，如骨痂或植物愈伤组织
senses.example: The X-ray showed a callosity where the bone had knit.
senses.exampleCN: X 光片显示骨折处已结出骨痂。
senses.why: The hard-skin idea extends to bone and tissue healing.
senses.whyCN: 「硬皮」之意延伸到骨骼与组织的愈合。

senses.title: Unfeeling hardness of heart
senses.definition: insensibility to the feelings of others
senses.definitionCN: 对他人的痛苦无动于衷
senses.example: His reply showed the callosity of a man long past shame.
senses.exampleCN: 他的回答显出一个久不知耻者的冷酷。
senses.why: Skin that feels nothing becomes a soul that feels nothing.
senses.whyCN: 无知觉的皮肤化为无知觉的心。

intro.en: Callosity comes from Latin callum, hard skin, plus the abstract suffix -itas.
intro.cn: callosity 由拉丁语 callum（硬皮）加抽象后缀 -itas 构成。

items.en: behind Latin callum lies a reconstructed root for hard or stony ground, uncertain in detail.
items.cn: 拉丁语 callum 背后是表示「硬、石质」的重构词根，细节不确定。

items.en: callum meant the hard skin of feet worn by walking.
items.cn: 拉丁语 callum 指因行走而磨硬的脚皮。

items.en: callositas named the state of being hardened.
items.cn: 拉丁语 callositas 指「硬化状态」。

items.en: callosity entered English for physical and then moral hardness.
items.cn: 十五至十六世纪 callosity 进入英语，先指身体硬化，后指心灵冷酷。

items.en: medical use prefers callus; callosity survives in literary and figurative writing.
items.cn: 医学上更常用 callus；callosity 留存于文学与比喻用法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the hard-skin root; the near-meaning group lists insensitivity words.
note.cn: 形近组同出「硬皮」词根；近义组是麻木类词。

entries.definitionCN: 钙，仅拼写相近，词源无关

normalIntro.en: Hands that grip forever grow the callosity that never feels.
normalIntro.cn: 永远紧握的手，会长出永不喊痛的茧。

normal.cn: 拉丁语 callum 意为硬皮。

normal.en: Callus is the medical word; callosity the literary one.
normal.cn: callus 是医学术语，callosity 偏文学。
形容词 callous 意为冷酷的。

normal.en: Moral callosity is the figurative use.
Calcium is unrelated despite the look.
normal.cn: calcium 与其拼写相近但词源无关。

abstract.en: Feel the smooth yellow ridge of a rower's palm.
abstract.cn: 感受船夫掌心那道光滑的黄茧。

abstract.en: See a refusal delivered with no flicker of feeling.
abstract.cn: 看一句拒绝说得毫无波澜。

abstract.en: Picture bark growing over a scarred trunk.
abstract.cn: 想象树皮盖住伤痕累累的树干。

examples.en: Blacksmith's callosities deepened with every forge year.
examples.cn: 铁匠的茧随每一年打铁而愈发厚实。

examples.en: The warden's moral callosity shocked the inspectors.
examples.cn: 典狱长的冷酷麻木令检查员震惊。

examples.en: A callosity formed along the healed fracture.
examples.cn: 愈合的骨折处长出了骨痂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「磕·老·茧」——手总「磕」在硬物上，时间久了就「老」出「茧」，与 callosity 的老茧义扣合。

root: callosity 源自拉丁语 callum「硬皮」加抽象后缀 -itas（callositas「硬化状态」）；本指磨出的老茧，延伸到骨痂，再借喻心灵的冷酷；同族词 callous、callus、callously 共享「硬」根。

sensesIntro.en: Skin hardened by labour, bone hardened in healing, and a heart hardened by habit.
sensesIntro.cn: 劳作磨硬的皮肤、愈合中变硬的骨骼，以及被习惯磨硬的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a palm whose skin has grown like bark.
core.cn: 核心意象：掌心皮肤硬得像树皮。

branches.en: callosities from forty seasons of labour
branches.cn: 四十年劳作磨出的老茧

branches.en: the skin that feels nothing, the heart that feels nothing
branches.cn: 无知觉的皮肤与无知觉的心

intro.en: The Latin hard-skin stem call- carries into callus, callous, and callosity.
intro.cn: 拉丁「硬皮」词干 call- 贯穿 callus、callous 与 callosity。

latinIntro.en: Latin callum, hard skin, plus -itas gives callositas.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 callum（硬皮）加 -itas 构成 callositas。
